body:
31 Oct, Karolis: one model per type (my version only), and NO animation redo.
Now (book v164): the tubes are back exactly where the Model movements maze trick and wheel run were made (the game places this gear at 4.4 size, as the movements pack says; the hamster fits the tubes at that size). Added only things that don't move the paths: round elbows at the joints, a firmer tube colour, an axle with 4 spokes so the wheel sits on its stand.
Pick in Model Compare → Hamster wheel and tube maze (🔔).
short: Check: tubes as the movements use them; nothing to redo
title: Hamster wheel and tube maze: ready for the existing movements
